newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint firms vs dlr,BCE Swiss franc futures active.
newsitem.headline: Forint firms vs dlr,BCE Swiss franc futures active.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed slightly firmer against the dollar on Tuesday and would have gained more, were it not for a major player's heavy dollar-buying on a corporate order, traders said.
"This opened the gap that separates the forint from the central bank's bid to some 50 pips (from 30 pips in the morning)," said Balazs Benczedi of West-LB Hungaria.
The forint finished at 175.45/50 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 175.55/60.
Benczedi added that as the one-off dollar-buying dies down, the forint should return to the central bank's bid.

On the Budapest Commodity Exchange, Swiss franc futures, which finished lower for four maturities, were the most popular, accounting for 2,600 contracts of a total 7,728 contracts or 1.22 billion forints turnover.
German mark and sterling futures also ended mostly lower, while Ecu, yen and Italian lira futures remained unchanged for most maturities.
Dollar futures rose for all but the February 1998 maturity.
